# Sergio Carrilho

> Tech Lead at Sony | Agile | AI | Kotlin Multiplatform

Sergio Carrilho is a technology leader and software engineer based in Tokyo, Japan. He graduated from the University of Tokyo's School of Engineering and currently works at Sony as a Tech Lead, where he has contributed to the launch of multiple products ranging from robotics systems to consumer smart devices. He has been practicing Agile software development since 2009.

## Site Sections

- [About](https://sergiocarrilho.com/about/): Professional bio, background, and skills.

- [Talks](https://sergiocarrilho.com/talks/): Conference presentations at KotlinConf, iOSDC, Agile Japan, and Sony events.
- [External Posts](https://sergiocarrilho.com/external/): Articles published on Medium and LinkedIn.
- [Tags](https://sergiocarrilho.com/tags/): Browse content by topic.

## Blog Posts

- [Understanding OpenClaw's Architecture (A High-Level Tour)](https://sergiocarrilho.com/posts/clawdbot-architecture/): A high-level tour of OpenClaw's AI agent architecture — how it connects messaging, LLMs, tools, and memory into a single control loop to act on your computer. Covers the Gateway, Brain (LLM), Hands (Tools), Memory, and Control Loop components.
- [AI Agents are Just People?](https://sergiocarrilho.com/posts/agents-are-people/): AI agents are just brain, hands, and memory — the same loop humans use to solve problems. Explores the structural mirror between biological cognition and digital agent architecture.

## Key Topics

Sergio writes and speaks about:
- **AI Agents**: Architecture, implementation patterns, coding agents, agentic workflows
- **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)**: Adoption at Sony, cross-platform mobile development with Compose Multiplatform
- **Agile Leadership**: ACE framework, lean waste reduction, adaptive leadership, team dynamics
- **Software Engineering**: System architecture, scalable systems, product development
